svg.title: overall
svg.desc: HttpArena normalized overall scores; each profile contributes up to 100 points. Missing profile contributions are not measured zeroes; coverage is shown for each server.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(97%,98%,98%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(87%,21%,0%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.aria-label: Normalized throughput points / higher is better / maximum 100 points per profile, 200 total
Both profiles contribute equally. Bar segments show each profile's contribution.
512 connections / lite mode / 1 run per server and profile
Local measurement. Hardware and run date not supplied. One run: variability not estimated.
